ordinate: KN sin(phi), as labelled by the manual; already a lever in metres, not KN to be multiplied again by sin(phi)
trimConvention: Signed initial trim as printed; trim is modified during heel to meet constant LCB
densityNote: Mass ordinates retained exactly; no displacement-to-volume conversion or assumed reference density applied.
limitations: Positive starboard heel only; port ordinates have not been fabricated.
Initial trim is not fixed trim during heel. Do not feed this dataset to a fixed-zero-trim solver.
Downflooding tables following each set are not cross-curve ordinates and are excluded.
Source page 59 states no unprotected progressive-flooding openings up to 40 degrees; this is not an unrestricted 60-degree operating limit.
